en.Accept HesabPay wallet, AFN, AfPay and i: Accept HesabPay wallet, AFN, AfPay and international card payments
en.Customers are not charged. Use a key fro: Customers are not charged. Use a key from the HesabPay sandbox dashboard.
Real money will be taken from customers. Use a live key from the HesabPay dashboard.
and copy the API key from the dashboard.
en.The API key stays on the server. It is n: The API key stays on the server. It is never sent to the browser or the mobile app.
en.Checkout will show a \"not configured\": Checkout will show a "not configured" message until a key is saved for the environment you selected.
en.HesabPay tells this store that a payment: HesabPay tells this store that a payment succeeded by calling the address below. Copy it into the HesabPay dashboard, under Developer, then Webhooks, then Add Webhook. Subscribe to both payment_success and payment_failure.
en.The webhook address is unavailable. Acti: The webhook address is unavailable. Activate the HesabPay extension and reload this page to see it.
en.An order is only marked as paid after He: An order is only marked as paid after HesabPay confirms it here. Without this, orders stay pending forever and customers are never told their payment worked.
en.One option covers all of these:: One option covers all of these:
en.Customers are taken to the HesabPay chec: Customers are taken to the HesabPay checkout page to pay, then returned to this store.
